turns.text: Hi there! How's it going today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I travel a lot for work. Planes, trains, hotel rooms.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then weight and battery matter. Would you go for the lightest possible laptop, or accept a bit more weight for a bigger battery?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on, I've got to pick this up. Stay quiet until I come back to you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hello, this is the right number for the vet?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My cat hasn't eaten since yesterday.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should I bring him in today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Four o'clock, okay. Thank you so much.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, off the phone. Sorry about that.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Welcome back. Your travel laptop. Lightest, or longest battery?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Lightest. My back is done with heavy bags.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then something around one kilo. Carry a small power bank for long trips.
